description: Top-level index that cross-references every extracted Fusion 360 CAM module (2D operations, 3D operations, multiaxis, turning). Consumed by Fusion360FunctionIndexEngine for lookup, dependency tracing, and AI orchestration.

modules.description: 2D Adaptive, 2D Pocket, 2D Contour, Face, Slot, Trace, Engrave, Thread, Bore, Circular, Chamfer
Adaptive Clearing 3D, Pocket Clearing, Parallel, Contour, Steep and Shallow, Scallop, Pencil, Morphed Spiral, Radial, Spiral, Project
Swarf, Multi-Axis Contour, Flow, Rotary, Multi-Axis Pocket, Blade, Impeller
Turning Profile Roughing/Finishing, Face, Thread, Groove, Cutoff, Bore, Secondary Spindle, Live Tooling
Legacy comprehensive catalog with 3D, multiaxis, turning, probing and API surface
Detailed 2D toolpath parameter enumeration with all tabs and parameter metadata
Probing toolpaths — WCS setup (8 ops), geometry inspection (sphere + hole pattern), tool measurement (length/diameter/breakage), in-process inspection (3 ops). Renishaw OMP/RMP-compatible.

Additive manufacturing toolpaths — DED (4 ops: thin-wall, wide-area, multi-axis lattice, repair), PBF/SLM (3 ops: part, support, lattice infill), FDM (3 ops: part, support, infill pattern), Hybrid (2 ops: cycled DED+mill, near-net+finish). Manufacturing Extension surface.

Sheet cutting toolpaths — laser cutting (3 ops: cutting, etching, drilling), waterjet (3 ops: abrasive, pure-water, 5-axis tapered), plasma (3 ops: cutting, bevel, mark). 9 toolpaths covering 2D contour with kerf compensation, lead-in/out, pierce strategies.

Inspection-extension toolpaths — CMM planning + sampling strategy (2 ops), tolerance stack analysis RSS + Monte Carlo + surface form + compare-to-CAD (4 ops), GD&T validate / zone-check + probe compensation calibrate (3 ops), inspection report + certificate of conformance (2 ops). 11 toolpaths complementing MS1-01 Probing — focuses on planning, analysis, validation, and reporting layers above raw probe macros.

Mill-turn toolpaths — synchronization (4 ops: turning_transfer, part_catcher, mill_turn_sync, bar_feed_advance), auxiliary (2 ops: tailstock, steady_rest), C-axis (2 ops: indexed mill, interpolated mill), multi-axis (4 ops: Y-axis offcenter turning, polygon turning, thread whirling, cross-drilling live). 12 toolpaths covering true dual-channel mill-turn capability for Integrex/NTX/CTX-class machines.
